metadata.description: A compiled, interactive Typed Runtime Graph demonstration for the RML Configuration Builder.

nodes.description: Switches between the interactive demo, ordinary settings and a short learning page.

children.description: Live values calculated by the compiled Runtime Graph.
children.customValidator: Compile and run the generated mod to receive live values.

children.description: Impulse counters from Apply, blocked and reset paths.
children.customValidator: Press one of the demo buttons after compiling the mod.

children.description: Controls the Apply branch. Disable it to watch the False path count pulses.
The graph multiplies this value by two and publishes the result live.
Uses Set Configuration Visibility to reveal the initially hidden Details Inline Row.
Switches the Demo Controls Inline Row between horizontal and vertical layout at runtime.
Shows or hides the left-side label of the Apply button cell at runtime.

children.label: Demo Controls
children.description: A 65/20/15 Inline Row controlled by the Runtime Graph.
This draft is saved before Apply runs, so the button action does not reset the text.
children.defaultValue: Hello from the compiled Runtime Graph!

children.description: Saves all current menu drafts, branches on Demo Enabled and applies the runtime widths.
Saves drafts, removes runtime menu overrides and restores the Configuration Outline layout.

children.label: Runtime Details
children.description: Initially hidden as a complete row; Show Runtime Details reveals it through graph logic.
A child of a runtime-controlled hidden Inline Row.
children.defaultValue: This complete row was revealed by Set Configuration Visibility.

children.description: A second control proving that the entire Inline Row becomes visible.
A normal enum setting included to demonstrate the generated picker control.
An HDR-capable colorX setting rendered by the shared color picker.
A regular validated slider from 0.5 to 2.0.
A compact walkthrough stored directly inside the generated example menu.
children.defaultValue: Compile → open the menu → edit the message → press Apply + Save → toggle the runtime controls.

children.description: An ordinary URI field with the shared copy action.
